stories.title: Ahold Delhaize Takes Systems Offline Following Cybersecurity Incident
stories.description: Ahold Delhaize has taken some systems offline after identifying a security issue within its network, the food retail group said on October 12, 2026.

stories.title: Google DevSite Flaw Let Attackers Execute Remote Code Through Forged Flask Sessions
stories.description: A critical vulnerability in Google’s shared DevSite platform could have allowed an unauthenticated attacker to forge Flask session cookies and trigger remote code execution across several Google-owned developer websites.

stories.title: IonQ to Acquire Zero Trust Firm Elisity for Up to $1.3 Billion
stories.description: The all-stock deal brings Elisity’s least-privilege access technology into IonQ’s security portfolio.

stories.title: Critical GitLab Vulnerability Enables Arbitrary Code Execution Attacks on Servers
stories.description: GitLab has released urgent security updates to fix a critical vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected servers without logging in.

stories.title: WhatsApp Attachment Deploys Malware That Gains SYSTEM Access on Windows
stories.description: Hackers use malicious WhatsApp attachments to deploy VulcanRAT, gaining SYSTEM-level access to steal data and control Windows PCs.

stories.title: Bricksforge WordPress Plugin Vulnerability Exploited in the Wild
stories.description: The vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-85097 can allow threat actors to take control of the targeted WordPress websites.

stories.title: Canonical Websites Disrupted in Second DDoS Attack This Year
stories.description: The outage hit the main Ubuntu and Canonical websites, including the Ubuntu blog and developer portal.

stories.title: Bring Your Own Agent: Your Employees' Assistants Are Already Logged In
stories.description: Personal AI agents can access work apps through OAuth grants, passwords, and API keys, while remaining outside managed agent consoles.

stories.title: Mastermind of 15,000-Mule Cybercrime Laundering Network Pleads Guilty in US
stories.description: Oleg Korniev was a leader of YMCO, a sophisticated network of money mules that helped hackers move funds outside the US.

stories.title: Ledger Finds Unauthorized Hardware Implant in CryptoBilis-Sold Wallet Amid Fund Theft Reports
stories.description: Ledger confirmed an unauthorized hardware implant in one CryptoBilis-sold device amid fund loss reports and paused sales through the reseller.

stories.title: Critical SonicWall SMA 1000 Flaw Targeted in 135 Exploitation Attempts After Patch
stories.description: Attackers have made 135 attempts to exploit a patched pre-auth SSRF flaw in SonicWall SMA 1000 appliances, originating from two U.S. IPs.
